name: Umfutho wegazi ophezulu
tagline: Umbulali othule - 1 kwabangu-3 abantu abadala baseNingizimu Afrika.

urgent.heading: Shayela ku-10177 noma uqonde esibhedlela uma
urgent.primary_message: Inkinga yomfutho wegazi ophezulu (i-BP engaphezu kuka-180/120 enezimpawu) iyisimo esiphuthumayo. Ungalindi — kungabangela isifo sohlangothi noma isifo senhliziyo.
red_flags: Ukufundwa kwe-BP ngaphezu kuka-180/120 kanye nezimpawu
Ikhanda elibuhlungu elibuhlungu elinenkinga yokubona noma isiyezi
Ubuthakathaka obungazelelwe, ukuba ndikindiki, noma ukudideka (kungaba isifo sohlangothi)
Isicanucanu, ukuhlanza, noma ukukhathazeka okukhulu nge-BP ephezulu
Ukopha ekhaleni okungeke kume ndawonye nokufunda i-BP ephezulu
Igazi emchameni noma ukulahlekelwa ngokuzumayo kokulawula esinyeni

what_is_it.heading: Umfutho wegazi ngokwemibandela ecacile
what_is_it.lede: Umfutho wegazi ungamandla egazi eliphusha ezindongeni zemithambo yakho. Uma lawo mandla ehlala ephakeme kakhulu isikhathi eside, alimaza imithambo nezitho ezinikezayo - buthule, iminyaka.
paragraphs: Ukufundwa okuvamile cishe ku-120/80. Umfutho wegazi ophakeme (umfutho wegazi ophezulu) uvamise ukuba ngu-140/90 noma ngaphezulu, ulinganiswa izikhathi ezingaphezu kwesisodwa. Inombolo yokuqala ingcindezi lapho inhliziyo ishaya, eyesibili ingcindezi phakathi kwezigqi.

Abantu abaningi abanomfutho wegazi ophezulu bazizwa bephile saka. Umonakalo wakha buthule ngemuva - enhliziyweni, ubuchopho, izinso, namehlo - kuze kube yilapho kwenzeka okuthile okubucayi njengokushaywa yisifo sohlangothi noma isifo senhliziyo. Yingakho wonke umuntu omdala edinga ukuhlolwa njalo, ngisho noma uzizwa uphilile.

items.headline: 1 ku3
items.body: Abantu abadala baseNingizimu Afrika banomfutho wegazi ophezulu. Abaningi abazi.

items.headline: Athule
items.body: Ngokuvamile azikho izimpawu kuze kube yilapho umonakalo sewenziwe. Ukufunda kuphela okukutshela iqiniso.

items.headline: Kuyalapheka
items.body: Ukuhlolwa kwamahhala kanye nemithi yamahhala kuyo yonke imitholampilo. Izimo eziningi zilawulwa ngethebhulethi eyodwa yansuku zonke.

items.headline: Inzuzo enkulu
items.body: Ukwehlisa umfutho wegazi kunciphisa ingozi yokushaywa unhlangothi ifike ku-40% kanye nengozi yokuhlaselwa yinhliziyo ifike ku-25%.

pull_quote.text: Uma ungazange uhlolwe umfutho wegazi onyakeni odlule, kwenze kule nyanga. Kuthatha imizuzwana engama-30. Kungengeza iminyaka eyi-10 empilweni yakho.
pull_quote.source: Inhlangano yaseNingizimu Afrika Yomfutho Wegazi Ophakeme

signs.heading: Ongase uzizwe - nalokho ovame ukungakuzwa
signs.lede: Umfutho wegazi ophezulu ubizwa ngokuthi umbulali othule ngenxa yesizathu. Abantu abaningi bazizwa bejwayelekile ngokuphelele. Okuwukuphela kwesibonakaliso esinokwethenjelwa ukufunda ngokwako.

items.title: Ngokuvamile - lutho
items.description: Abantu abaningi abanomfutho wegazi ophezulu abanazo nhlobo izimpawu. Abaningi bathola kuphela lapho beshaywa unhlangothi noma isifo senhliziyo.

items.title: Lapho ukufundwa kuphezulu kakhulu
items.description: Ikhanda elibuhlungu elibuhlungu, ukungaboni kahle, ubuhlungu besifuba, ukuphefumula kanzima, noma ukuphuma kwegazi ekhaleni kungenzeka - kodwa emazingeni ayingozi kuphela. Lezi izimo eziphuthumayo.

items.title: Themba umshini, hhayi imizwa
items.description: Izimpawu azikwazi ukukutshela umfutho wegazi lakho. Ngisho nabantu abanomfutho wegazi ophakeme kakhulu bavame ukuzizwa bephile kahle. Ukufunda kuphela okuyiqiniso.

items.myth: Uma ngizizwa nginomfutho wegazi ophezulu, ngangizokwazi.
items.fact: Cishe ngokuqinisekile ubungeke. I-Hypertension ithule kubantu abaningi. Okuwukuphela kwendlela yokwazi ukulinganisa.

items.myth: Ngidinga kuphela ukukhathazeka ngosawoti uma ngiwufaka etafuleni.
items.fact: Usawoti omningi esiwudlayo ufihliwe - esinkwa, inyama egayiwe, izimpushana zesobho, okudliwayo, ngisho noshizi othile. I-shaker iyingxenye encane.

items.myth: Uma umfutho wegazi wami usujwayelekile, ngiyakwazi ukumisa amaphilisi.
items.fact: Umfutho wegazi lakho ujwayelekile ngenxa yamaphilisi. Bamise, bese ikhwela ihlehla. I-Hypertension ilawulwa, ayilashwa.

items.myth: Imithi yomfutho wegazi inemiphumela emibi kakhulu.
items.fact: Imithi yanamuhla ibekezelelwa kahle abantu abaningi. Uma eyakho idala izinkinga, tshela umtholampilo wakho - ziningi ezinye izindlela ongakhetha kuzo.

prevention.heading: Uzigcina kanjani izinombolo zakho ziphansi
prevention.lede: Ngisho nezinguquko ezincane zendlela yokuphila zingehlisa umfutho wegazi ngamaphuzu angu-5-10. Abantu abaningi abathola ukwelashwa bangehlisa umthamo wabo ngokusebenza ngendlela efanayo yokuphila ngokuhambisana.

items.title: Usawoti omncane
items.description: Pheka ngamakhambi, ilamula, i-garlic, izinongo. Funda amalebula - noma yini engaphezu kuka-1.5g kasawoti ku-100g iphezulu. Khomba ukuthi ube ngaphansi kuka-5g kasawoti ngosuku isiyonke.

items.title: Hambisa nsuku zonke
items.description: Imizuzu engama-30 yokuhamba ushesha, izinsuku ezi-5 ngeviki, yehlisa umfutho wegazi ngokulinganiswa phakathi kwamasonto. Mahhala, itholakala yonke indawo.

items.title: Isisindo esinempilo
items.description: Ukulahlekelwa ngisho no-5 kg ​​kungehlisa kakhulu umfutho wegazi. Gxila ekushintsheni okunensayo, okungaguquki - hhayi ukudla okudlayo.

items.title: Check regularly
items.description: Wonke umuntu omdala kufanele akalwe umfutho wegazi okungenani minyaka yonke - kaningi uma esemnceleni noma ngaphezulu kwama-50. Kumahhala kuyo yonke imitholampilo nasemakhemisi amaningi.

items.title: Uma ungakaze uhlolwe, noma sekuphele unyaka
items.description: Hamba kunoma yimuphi umtholampilo kahulumeni noma ikhemisi ubuze. Imizuzu emibili. Ayikho i-aphoyintimenti. Mahhala.

items.title: Uma ukufunda kwakho kuphezulu kanye
items.description: Iphinde ihlolwe emasontweni angu-1-2 alandelayo. Ukufundwa okuphezulu okukodwa akusona isifo - kepha kuyisizathu sokuqinisekisa.

items.title: Uma uxilongwa
items.description: Qala imithi njengoba uyalelwe. Thatha nsuku zonke ngesikhathi esifanayo. Ukweqa imithamo kuvumela ingcindezi ukuthi inyuke futhi yehle - kubi kakhulu kunomfutho ophezulu ozinzile.

items.title: Uma uzizwa kahle kodwa une-hypertension
items.description: Ungawuyeki umuthi wakho. Iphuzu lokwelashwa ukuzizwa uphilile ngenkathi ugcina izinombolo ziphephile. Qhubeka njengoba kushiwo.

items.title: Landelela izinombolo zakho
items.description: Thenga ikhabethe lasekhaya uma ukwazi (cishe u-R400 emakhemisi amaningi). Funda kanye noma kabili ngesonto. Letha ilogi ekuvakasheni komtholampilo.

get_help.heading: Uzoqala kuphi
get_help.lede: Ukunakekelwa komfutho wegazi kungenye yezinto imitholampilo yomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika eyenza kahle kakhulu. Ngena. Ayikho i-aphoyintimenti edingekayo.

helplines.name: Thola umtholampilo oseduze nawe
helplines.description: Yonke imitholampilo kahulumeni ihlinzeka ngokuhlolwa komfutho wegazi mahhala kanye nemithi yomugqa wokuqala yamahhala
helplines.meta: Akukho ukuqokwa · alukho usizo lwezokwelapha oludingekayo · Umazisi uyasiza

helplines.name: I-Heart and Stroke Foundation SA
helplines.description: Ulwazi, ukusekela, namathuluzi amahhala okuhlola ubungozi

items.heading: Ukuthi umfutho wegazi ophezulu ulimaza kanjani umzimba
paragraphs: Umfutho wegazi ungamandla egazi eliphusha ezindongeni zemithambo yakho. Lapho ihlala iphakeme iminyaka, lawo mandla engeziwe angashintshi ayaqina kancane futhi awanciphise.

Yingakho umfutho wegazi ongelashiwe unyusa buthule ingozi yokushaywa unhlangothi, isifo senhliziyo, ukulimala kwezinso nokulahlekelwa ukubona isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuba uzwe lutho. Ukuthula yikho okwenza kube yingozi.

items.heading: Kusho ukuthini lezi zinombolo ezimbili
paragraphs: Inombolo ephezulu (systolic) ingcindezi lapho inhliziyo yakho ishaya; inombolo engezansi (diastolic) ingcindezi lapho ihlezi phakathi kwezigqi.
Ngaphansi kuka-120/80 kunempilo. I-140/90 noma ngaphezulu ngaphezu kosuku olulodwa iphezulu. I-180/120 enezimpawu kuyisimo esiphuthumayo - qonda esibhedlela.

items.heading: Ukwelashwa eNingizimu Afrika
paragraphs: Imitholampilo kahulumeni ihlinzeka ngemithi yomfutho wegazi mahhala. Abantu abaningi badinga ithebhulethi engaphezu kweyodwa ukuze bafinyelele izinga eliphephile, okuyinto evamile, hhayi uphawu lokwehluleka.
Umuthi usebenza kuphela ngenkathi uwuphuza. Ukuma lapho uzizwa uphilile yisona sizathu esivame ukukhuphuka siphindele phezulu.
